channel-type.label: Software Version
channel-type.description: Firmware version of the device

channel-type.label: Serial Number
channel-type.description: Serial number of the device

channel-type.label: Production Date
channel-type.description: Manufacturing date of the device

channel-type.label: Time Zone
channel-type.description: Time zone configured on the device

channel-type.label: Installed Peak Power
channel-type.description: Peak power of the installed photovoltaic system

channel-type.label: Inverter Count
channel-type.description: Number of inverters in the system

channel-type.label: Battery Count
channel-type.description: Number of batteries in the system

channel-type.label: Mode
channel-type.description: Operating mode of the energy management system

channel-type.label: Set Power Mode
channel-type.description: Forces a battery mode for a number of poll cycles: auto, idle:cycles or charge, discharge, grid_charge:watts:cycles

channel-type.label: Coupling Mode
channel-type.description: How the power plant is coupled to the grid

channel-type.label: Emergency Power Status
channel-type.description: State of the emergency power supply

channel-type.label: Charging Lock
channel-type.description: Battery charging is currently blocked

channel-type.label: Discharging Lock
channel-type.description: Battery discharging is currently blocked

channel-type.label: Emergency Power Available
channel-type.description: Emergency power reserve is available

channel-type.label: Charging Throttled
channel-type.description: Battery charging is currently limited

channel-type.label: Grid Limit Active
channel-type.description: Grid consumption is currently limited

channel-type.label: Charging Time Lock
channel-type.description: Battery charging is blocked by a time window

channel-type.label: Discharging Time Lock
channel-type.description: Battery discharging is blocked by a time window

channel-type.label: Weather Regulated Charge
channel-type.description: Charging follows the weather forecast

channel-type.label: Power Limits Used
channel-type.description: Configured power limits are active

channel-type.label: Power Save
channel-type.description: Power saving mode is active

channel-type.label: Set Manual Charge Energy
channel-type.description: Start a manual battery charge with this energy, sent to the device in Wh

channel-type.label: Idle Periods
channel-type.description: Periods during which the battery is locked against charging or discharging, one period per line as name:days:mode:active:hh:mm-hh:mm

channel-type.label: Block Charging
channel-type.description: Blocks charging of the battery on all days around the clock with an idle period of its own and switches on the use of idle periods. See the thing actions getIdlePeriods and setIdlePeriods

channel-type.label: Block Discharging
channel-type.description: Blocks discharging of the battery on all days around the clock with an idle period of its own and switches on the use of idle periods. See the thing actions getIdlePeriods and setIdlePeriods

channel-type.label: Derate at Percent
channel-type.description: Share of the installed peak power at which the feed in is reduced

channel-type.label: Derate at Power
channel-type.description: Power at which the feed in is reduced

channel-type.label: Idle Periods Enabled
channel-type.description: Whether the device uses the configured idle periods

channel-type.label: Manual Charge Energy
channel-type.description: Energy of the manual battery charge started last
